about.title: About Me
about.p1: I’m a passionate full-stack web developer who loves turning ideas into reality through code. What started as simple curiosity became a deep passion for building, solving problems, and exploring new technologies.
about.p2: I thrive on challenges they push me to grow and create smarter solutions. Beyond web development, I’m also diving into game development, where creativity and logic come together in fascinating ways.
about.p3: For me, coding isn’t just a job it’s a journey of constant learning, discovery, and creation.

portfolio.title: Web Portfolio
description: Custom-built responsive web application designed to showcase my projects, skills, and experience.

pilote.title: Pilote360
description: Design of a SaaS platform enabling centralization, visualization, and strategic analysis of finances for businesses and individuals.
Development of interactive decision tools and integration of invoice and trial management systems.
Implementation of automations via n8n for customer notifications and financial process management.

winedge.title: Winedge
description: Design of a FinTech solution for silent savings calculated automatically on daily transaction round-ups.
Development of real-time conversion system for saved amounts into crypto-assets.
Implementation of user account registry and tracking of allocated balances.
Automation of email scenarios and notifications via n8n.

cloud.title: Cloud SOIBY
description: Cloud hosting and web infrastructure management platform (under active development).
Implementation of the offer management engine, subscription models, and automatic plan renewal.

sco_app.title: SCO App
description: Design and development of a centralized web application enabling the administration to optimize tracking and processing of student records.
Implementation of a robust API with Flask, PostgreSQL database management, and integration of Ably service for real-time notifications and stream management.

kosher.title: NeedKOSHER
description: Design and production of a multi-service web application aimed at strengthening interactions and service sharing within the community.
Integration of interaction modules covering event management, travel, catering, and community mutual aid.
Development of a reactive frontend interface with Nuxt.js coupled with a REST API under Express.js, Sequelize, and MySQL.

finflow.title: UACEEM FinFlowImg
description: Design and implementation of the university's central financial management module, covering the student registration through to analytical tracking of internal flows.
Implementation of the transaction engine for various operations and creation of financial dashboards for real-time visualization and reporting.
Technical mentoring of interns on the project, assistance with architecture design, and management of GitHub branch strategy.

uaceem_site.title: UACEEM website v1
description: Design and development of the official website (V1) for ACEEM University.

call_law.title: Call-Law
description: Design and development of a mobile application enabling connections between clients and lawyers for legal consultation management.
Integration of a fluid mobile interface developed with React Native (TypeScript) connected to a REST API under Django.
Implementation of the slot planning system, request tracking, and appointment status monitoring.

mtp_urgence.title: MTP Urgence
description: Design and development of a web application aimed at streamlining control and centralizing the sharing of emergency data between central and regional services.
Implementation of the incident qualification system, automatic assignment of responsible parties, and real-time tracking of remediation interventions.
Development of a reactive user interface under Quasar (Vue.js) coupled with a Laravel backend and PostgreSQL database.
